title: Oscar Wolfe deathbed interview about S4 autopsy film and gray alien

tellings.quote: when I brought Richard Dolan in to interview this man as he was dying on like I think it was like a dialysis machine

plain: A dying man named Oscar Wolfe is said to have described seeing a film of an autopsy at S4, a secret site at Area 51, the classified test base in Nevada, and a gray alien, the small grey-skinned being of UFO stories. Jeremy Corbell tells Michels he set up the interview himself, bringing in a researcher named Richard Dolan to question the man "as he was dying on like I think it was like a dialysis machine", and he points to Wolfe's DD-214s, US military discharge papers, as proof of his service; a man named Ruben Langdon is also named. If true, it would mean bodies of non-human beings were studied at Area 51.
